verses.original: כִּי־ יִמָּצֵ֣א חָלָ֗ל בָּאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ נֹתֵ֤ן לְךָ֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ נֹפֵ֖ל בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע מִ֥י הִכָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·mā·ṣê ḥā·lāl bā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā lə·riš·tāh nō·p̄êl baś·śā·ḏeh lō nō·w·ḏa‘ mî hik·kā·hū
verses.literal: If one is found slain lying in a field in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess and it is not known who killed him
verses.literalPt: Se, na terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando para a possuíres, for achado um morto, caído no campo, sem que se saiba quem o matou,

verses.original: וְיָצְא֥וּ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יךָ וּמָדְדוּ֙ אֶל־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבֹ֥ת הֶחָלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣə·’ū zə·qê·ne·ḵā wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭe·ḵā ū·mā·ḏə·ḏū ’el- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇōṯ he·ḥā·lāl
verses.literal: your elders and judges must come out and measure the distance from the victim to the neighboring cities
verses.literalPt: sairão os teus anciãos e os teus juízes e dali medirão até às cidades que estão ao redor daquele que foi morto.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הָעִ֔יר הַקְּרֹבָ֖ה אֶל־ הֶחָלָ֑ל וְלָֽקְח֡וּ זִקְנֵי֩ הָעִ֨יר הַהִ֜וא עֶגְלַ֣ת בָּקָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ עֻבַּד֙ בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ מָשְׁכָ֖ה בְּעֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hā·‘îr haq·qə·rō·ḇāh ’el- he·ḥā·lāl wə·lā·qə·ḥū ziq·nê hā·‘îr ha·hi·w ‘eḡ·laṯ bā·qār ’ă·šer lō- ‘ub·baḏ bāh ’ă·šer lō- mā·šə·ḵāh bə·‘ōl
verses.literal: Then the elders . . . . . . of the city nearest the victim shall take a heifer . . . that has never been yoked or used for work
verses.literalPt: Na cidade que está mais próxima ao morto, os anciãos tomarão da manada uma novilha, que ainda não tenha trabalhado, nem tenha puxado com o jugo;

verses.original: וְהוֹרִ֡דוּ זִקְנֵי֩ הָעִ֨יר הַהִ֤וא אֶת־ הָֽעֶגְלָה֙ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל אֵיתָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ יֵעָבֵ֥ד בּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִזָּרֵ֑עַ וְעָֽרְפוּ־ שָׁ֥ם אֶת־ הָעֶגְלָ֖ה בַּנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ri·ḏū ziq·nê hā·‘îr ha·hi·w ’eṯ- hā·‘eḡ·lāh ’el- na·ḥal ’ê·ṯān ’ă·šer lō- yê·‘ā·ḇêḏ bōw wə·lō yiz·zā·rê·a‘ wə·‘ā·rə·p̄ū- šām ’eṯ- hā·‘eḡ·lāh ban·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: bring - - the heifer to a valley with running water that has not been plowed or sown and break its neck there by the stream
verses.literalPt: dessa cidade trarão a novilha a um vale de águas vivas, o qual não foi lavrado, nem semeado, e ali no vale quebrarão o pescoço à novilha.

verses.original: וְנִגְּשׁ֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִים֮ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִי֒ כִּ֣י בָ֗ם בָּחַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֖ךְ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְעַל־ פִּיהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־ רִ֥יב וְכָל־ נָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nig·gə·šū hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê lê·wî kî ḇām bā·ḥar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·šā·rə·ṯōw ū·lə·ḇā·rêḵ bə·šêm Yah·weh wə·‘al- pî·hem yih·yeh kāl- rîḇ wə·ḵāl nā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come forward for the LORD your God has chosen them to serve Him and pronounce blessings in His name and to give a ruling . . . . . . in every dispute . . . and case of assault
verses.literalPt: Chegar-se-ão os sacerdotes, filhos de Levi, porque Jeová, teu Deus, os escolheu para o servirem e para abençoarem no que concerne ao nome de Jeová. Segundo a sua sentença, se decidirá toda demanda e todo ferimento.

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל זִקְנֵי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַהִ֔וא הַקְּרֹבִ֖ים אֶל־ הֶחָלָ֑ל יִרְחֲצוּ֙ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ הָעֶגְלָ֖ה הָעֲרוּפָ֥ה בַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ziq·nê hā·‘îr ha·hi·w haq·qə·rō·ḇîm ’el- he·ḥā·lāl yir·ḥă·ṣū ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- hā·‘eḡ·lāh hā·‘ă·rū·p̄āh ḇan·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Then all the elders of the city . . . nearest the victim shall wash their hands by the stream over the heifer whose neck has been broken
verses.literalPt: Todos os anciãos dessa cidade que são os mais próximos ao morto lavarão as mãos sobre a novilha cujo pescoço foi quebrado no vale

verses.original: וְעָנ֖וּ וְאָמְר֑וּ יָדֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֤א שָׁפְכָה אֶת־ הַדָּ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְעֵינֵ֖ינוּ לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nū wə·’ā·mə·rū yā·ḏê·nū lō šå̄·p̄ə·ḵå̄h ’eṯ- had·dām haz·zeh wə·‘ê·nê·nū lō rā·’ū
verses.literal: and they shall declare . . . Our hands did not shed this blood nor did our eyes see it
verses.literalPt: e dirão: As nossas mãos não derramaram este sangue, nem os nossos olhos o viram.

verses.original: כַּפֵּר֩ לְעַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדִ֙יתָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְאַל־ תִּתֵּן֙ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֔י בְּקֶ֖רֶב עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִכַּפֵּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם הַדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kap·pêr lə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- pā·ḏî·ṯā Yah·weh wə·’al- tit·tên dām nā·qî bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl wə·nik·kap·pêr lā·hem had·dām
verses.literal: Accept this atonement O LORD for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them . . . . . . And the bloodshed will be atoned for
verses.literalPt: Perdoa, ó Jeová, ao teu povo de Israel, que remiste, e não ponhas o sangue inocente no meio dele. O sangue lhe será perdoado.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּבַעֵ֛ר הַדָּ֥ם הַנָּקִ֖י מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ḇa·‘êr had·dām han·nā·qî miq·qir·be·ḵā kî- ṯa·‘ă·śeh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So you shall purge from among you the guilt of shedding innocent blood since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Tu exterminarás o sangue inocente do meio de ti, quando fizeres o que é reto aos olhos de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֥א לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וּנְתָנ֞וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ בְּיָדֶ֖ךָ וְשָׁבִ֥יתָ שִׁבְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·ṣê lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ū·nə·ṯā·nōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·šā·ḇî·ṯā šiḇ·yōw
verses.literal: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive
verses.literalPt: Quando saíres à peleja contra os teus inimigos, e Jeová, teu Deus, os entregar nas tuas mãos, e os levares cativos,

verses.original: וְרָאִיתָ֙ בַּשִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֵ֖שֶׁת יְפַת־ תֹּ֑אַר וְחָשַׁקְתָּ֣ בָ֔הּ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯā baš·šiḇ·yāh ’ê·šeṯ yə·p̄aṯ- tō·’ar wə·ḥā·šaq·tā ḇāh wə·lā·qaḥ·tā lə·ḵā lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: if you see a beautiful . . . woman among them and you desire her and want to take her as your wife
verses.literalPt: e entre os cativos vires uma mulher formosa, e tiveres afeição a ela, e quiseres tomá-la por mulher,

verses.original: וַהֲבֵאתָ֖הּ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְגִלְּחָה֙ אֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה אֶת־ צִפָּרְנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḇê·ṯāh ’el- tō·wḵ bê·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḡil·lə·ḥāh ’eṯ- rō·šāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh ’eṯ- ṣip·pā·rə·ne·hā
verses.literal: then you shall bring her into . . . your house She must shave her head trim her nails
verses.literalPt: introduzi-la-ás em tua casa. Ela rapará a cabeça, cortará as unhas

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֩ירָה֩ אֶת־ שִׂמְלַ֨ת שִׁבְיָ֜הּ מֵעָלֶ֗יהָ וְיָֽשְׁבָה֙ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ וּבָֽכְתָ֛ה אֶת־ אָבִ֥יהָ וְאֶת־ אִמָּ֖הּ יֶ֣רַח יָמִ֑ים וְאַ֨חַר כֵּ֜ן תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וּבְעַלְתָּ֔הּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·sî·rāh ’eṯ- śim·laṯ šiḇ·yāh mê·‘ā·le·hā wə·yā·šə·ḇāh bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇā·ḵə·ṯāh ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā wə·’eṯ- ’im·māh ye·raḥ yā·mîm wə·’a·ḥar kên tā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·hā ū·ḇə·‘al·tāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḵā lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: and put aside the clothing of her captivity After she has lived in your house a full month . . . and mourned her father and mother you may have relations with her and be her husband and she shall be your wife
verses.literalPt: e despirá o vestido do seu cativeiro; e ficará em tua casa, e chorará a seu pai e a sua mãe um mês inteiro. Depois disso, estarás com ela e serás seu marido, e ela será tua mulher.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־ לֹ֧א חָפַ֣צְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְשִׁלַּחְתָּהּ֙ לְנַפְשָׁ֔הּ וּמָכֹ֥ר לֹא־ תִמְכְּרֶ֖נָּה בַּכָּ֑סֶף לֹא־ תִתְעַמֵּ֣ר בָּ֔הּ תַּ֖חַת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִנִּיתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- lō ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā bāh wə·šil·laḥ·tāh lə·nap̄·šāh ū·mā·ḵōr lō- ṯim·kə·ren·nāh bak·kā·sep̄ lō- ṯiṯ·‘am·mêr bāh ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ‘in·nî·ṯāh
verses.literal: And if you are not pleased with her you are to let her go wherever she wishes But you must not sell her . . . for money . . . or treat her as a slave since you have dishonored her
verses.literalPt: Se não tiver prazer nela, deixá-la-ás ir aonde quiser; não a venderás por dinheiro, não a tratarás como escrava, porque a humilhaste.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִהְיֶ֨יןָ לְאִ֜ישׁ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֗ים הָאַחַ֤ת אֲהוּבָה֙ וְהָאַחַ֣ת שְׂנוּאָ֔ה וְיָֽלְדוּ־ ל֣וֹ בָנִ֔ים הָאֲהוּבָ֖ה וְהַשְּׂנוּאָ֑ה וְהָיָ֛ה הַבֵּ֥ן הַבְּכ֖וֹר לַשְּׂנִיאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯih·ye·nā lə·’îš šə·tê nā·šîm hā·’a·ḥaṯ ’ă·hū·ḇāh wə·hā·’a·ḥaṯ śə·nū·’āh wə·yā·lə·ḏū- lōw ḇā·nîm hā·’ă·hū·ḇāh wə·haś·śə·nū·’āh wə·hā·yāh hab·bên hab·bə·ḵō·wr laś·śə·nî·’āh
verses.literal: If a man has two wives one beloved and the other unloved and both . . . bear him sons but the unloved wife has the firstborn son
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tiver duas mulheres, uma a quem ama e outra a quem aborrece, e ambas lhe derem filhos, e, se o filho da que ele aborrecer for o primogênito,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הַנְחִיל֣וֹ אֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֖ה ל֑וֹ לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל לְבַכֵּר֙ אֶת־ בֶּן־ הָ֣אֲהוּבָ֔ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י בֶן־ הַשְּׂנוּאָ֖ה הַבְּכֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm han·ḥî·lōw ’eṯ- bā·nāw ’êṯ ’ă·šer- yih·yeh lōw lō yū·ḵal lə·ḇak·kêr ’eṯ- ben- hā·’ă·hū·ḇāh ‘al- pə·nê ḇen- haś·śə·nū·’āh hab·bə·ḵōr
verses.literal: when that man . . . assigns his inheritance to his sons he must not appoint the son of the beloved wife as the firstborn over the son of the unloved wife . . .
verses.literalPt: no dia em que fizer herdar seus filhos aquilo que possuir, não poderá dar a primogenitura ao filho da amada, preferindo-o ao filho da aborrecida, que é o primogênito;

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת־ הַבְּכֹ֨ר בֶּן־ הַשְּׂנוּאָ֜ה יַכִּ֗יר לָ֤תֶת לוֹ֙ פִּ֣י שְׁנַ֔יִם בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּצֵ֖א ל֑וֹ כִּי־ הוּא֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית אֹנ֔וֹ ל֖וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḵōr ben- haś·śə·nū·’āh yak·kîr lā·ṯeṯ lōw pî šə·na·yim bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yim·mā·ṣê lōw kî- hū rê·šîṯ ’ō·nōw lōw miš·paṭ hab·bə·ḵō·rāh
verses.literal: Instead he must acknowledge the firstborn the son of his unloved wife by giving him a double portion of all that he has For that son is the firstfruits of his father’s strength the right of the firstborn belongs to him
verses.literalPt: porém reconhecerá o primogênito, o filho da aborrecida, dando-lhe dobrada porção de tudo quanto possui, porque ele é as primícias da tua virilidade. O direito da primogenitura lhe pertence.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִ֗ישׁ בֵּ֚ן סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֔ה אֵינֶ֣נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֔עַ בְּק֥וֹל אָבִ֖יו וּבְק֣וֹל אִמּ֑וֹ וְיסְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yih·yeh lə·’îš bên sō·w·rêr ū·mō·w·reh ’ê·nen·nū šō·mê·a‘ bə·qō·wl ’ā·ḇîw ū·ḇə·qō·wl ’im·mōw ws·sə·rū ’ō·ṯōw wə·lō yiš·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey . . . his father . . . and mother and does not listen to them when disciplined
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tiver um filho contumaz e rebelde, que não obedecer à voz de seu pai nem à voz de sua mãe, e, ainda que o castiguem, não lhes der ouvidos,

verses.original: וְתָ֥פְשׂוּ ב֖וֹ אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְהוֹצִ֧יאוּ אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֥י עִיר֖וֹ וְאֶל־ שַׁ֥עַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·p̄ə·śū ḇōw ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw wə·hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ziq·nê ‘î·rōw wə·’el- ša·‘ar mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: his father and mother are to lay hold of him and bring him to the elders of his city to the gate of his hometown
verses.literalPt: pegarão nele seu pai e sua mãe, e o levarão aos anciãos da cidade e à porta do seu lugar,

verses.original: וְאָמְר֞וּ אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֗וֹ בְּנֵ֤נוּ זֶה֙ סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמֹרֶ֔ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּקֹלֵ֑נוּ זוֹלֵ֖ל וְסֹבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ’el- ziq·nê ‘î·rōw bə·nê·nū zeh sō·w·rêr ū·mō·reh ’ê·nen·nū šō·mê·a‘ bə·qō·lê·nū zō·w·lêl wə·sō·ḇê
verses.literal: and say to the elders This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious he does not obey us . . . He is a glutton and a drunkard
verses.literalPt: e dirão aos anciãos da cidade: Este nosso filho é contumaz e rebelde, não obedece à nossa voz; é glutão e bêbado.

verses.original: וּ֠רְגָמֻהוּ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֤וֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ וָמֵ֔ת וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁמְע֥וּ וְיִרָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·ḡā·mu·hū kāl- ’an·šê ‘î·rōw ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wā·mêṯ ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yi·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Then all the men of his city will stone him . . . to death So you must purge the evil from among you and all Israel will hear and be afraid
verses.literalPt: Então, todos os homens da cidade o apedrejarão, até que morra. Assim, exterminarás o mal do meio de ti; e todo o Israel ouvirá e temerá.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִהְיֶ֣ה בְאִ֗ישׁ חֵ֛טְא מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֖וֶת וְהוּמָ֑ת וְתָלִ֥יתָ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ עֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yih·yeh ḇə·’îš ḥêṭ miš·paṭ- mā·weṯ wə·hū·māṯ wə·ṯā·lî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ‘êṣ
verses.literal: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death and he is executed and you hang his body on a tree
verses.literalPt: Se um homem tiver cometido um pecado digno de morte e for morto, e o pendurares num madeiro

verses.original: לֹא־ תָלִ֨ין נִבְלָת֜וֹ עַל־ הָעֵ֗ץ כִּֽי־ קָב֤וֹר תִּקְבְּרֶ֙נּוּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כִּֽי־ קִלְלַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים תָּל֑וּי וְלֹ֤א תְטַמֵּא֙ אֶת־ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯā·lîn niḇ·lā·ṯōw ‘al- hā·‘êṣ kî- qā·ḇō·wr tiq·bə·ren·nū bay·yō·wm ha·hū kî- qil·laṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm tā·lui wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mê ’eṯ- ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: you must not leave the body on the tree overnight but you must be sure to bury . . . him that day because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God’s curse You must not defile the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance
verses.literalPt: o seu cadáver não ficará toda a noite no madeiro, porém, certamente, no mesmo dia, o sepultarás; pois aquele que é pendurado é maldito de Deus. Não contaminarás a tua terra que Jeová, teu Deus, está dando por herança.
